title: Jedi Lightsaber
caption: Jedi Lightsaber (V)
game_text: Deploy on Mace or Yoda. {set:coruscant} sites may not cancel Force drain bonuses. May add 1 to a Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw 2 destiny (3 if on Yoda and defending). Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Elegant sword of pure energy. “This is the weapon of a Jedi Knight. Not as clumsy or as random as a blaster.” A lightsaber can be dangerous to an unskilled user.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Non-unique (no dot on slip, caption or printed card; wiki Unrestricted). Green Character Weapon frame, banner CHARACTER WEAPON. Inline icon before 'sites': a gold-rimmed pastel/pink rosette sphere = the Coruscant expansion symbol (matches the Game Aid sheet's Coruscant icon and the ring on the printed Mace Windu) → {set:coruscant}. SLIP DIFFERS FROM STUB: the stub reads it as 'Republic sites'. Margin credits: left 'Original concept by Brandon Ruck', right 'Tennessee State Winner 2004'. Lore corrected from both scans: the quotation closes after 'blaster.' — 'A lightsaber can be dangerous to an unskilled user.' is outside the quote (wiki wraps everything in straight single quotes); curly double quotes. The 745 px Premiere-L-jedilightsaber.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face, different game text) — downloaded to src/vs9/12-Premiere-L-jedilightsaber.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan (square-on 350×490) is the printed face used as src. Premiere: no ring icon. Copyright 1995 per set. Modern: V11-L-jedilightsaber.gif (745 px); VB5 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
